fields.description: The fields this signer completes. Absent: one signature at the default spot.

items.description: A field: page (1-based) and x/y/width/height as percentages of the page; settings are the provider's other field settings, re-applied as they are.

placement.description: Also accepted: the approval task's saved SignaturePlacement value - {fields:[...]} or an older single box {page,x,y,width,height}.

items.description: A field: page (1-based) and x/y/width/height as percentages of the page; settings are the provider's other field settings, re-applied as they are.

role.description: The recipient the field belongs to (one per approver who signs).

Get_provider_settings.description: Reads the signature.provider* rows from CORMS Admin Configuration. Set Site Address to the CORMS site.

body.error: Signing provider settings are incomplete. Complete the signature.provider* rows in Admin Configuration.

Layout_fields.description: Each recipient's fields in SignNow coordinates; the role names become the editor's recipients.

Editor_link_options.description: The editor returns to CORMS (returnUrl) when the user finishes, so the in-app window can close itself.

Create_editor_link.description: SignNow Embedded Editor: places and edits fields without sending the document.

Get_layout_document.description: The fields as the requestor left them in the editor.

Read_layout_fields.description: Back to CORMS's provider-neutral shape: page 1-based, position as % of the page; the other attributes are kept as settings.

Get_uploaded_document.description: Reads the page sizes needed to turn CORMS's percentage placement into SignNow coordinates.

Signature_placement.description: Where one signature goes when the signer has no fields (page 1-based, % of the page).

Page_size.description: That page's size from SignNow; US Letter when the document does not report it.
